campaign.title: The Wolverine Mirage
campaign.question: Do BPC-157 and TB-500 regenerate human tendons, or is it affiliate hype, rodent-only evidence and athletes who also do their rehab?
campaign.population: Adults with Achilles or rotator-cuff tendinopathy in sports-medicine clinics
campaign.target: No return to sport within a year

outcomes.label: No return to sport within a year
Re-injury or rupture within a year

1.name: The Rumour Dungeon
1.evidence: YouTube transcripts, Quora answers, Reddit (r/Peptides, r/Ozempic)
1.trap: Affiliate skew and echo chambers: sponsored codes and reposts make a handful of stories look like a movement.
1.rule: D_L1 = 15 x phi_affiliate + 15 x max(0, 1 - N_eff / 30)

2.name: The Forgotten Archives
2.evidence: PubMed / Europe PMC preprints, animal studies, open-label clinic logs
2.trap: Species gap and confounding: rat tendons are not human tendons, and peptide users are not average patients.
2.rule: D_L2 = 22 x tau_rodent + 20 x min(1, |beta_naive - beta_adj| / |beta_naive|)

3.name: The Temple of Replication
3.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov registry and multi-site EHR subgroup replication
3.trap: The RCT void and p-hacking: no completed human trial, one lab citing itself, and the best of many subgroups.
3.rule: D_L3 = 20 x I(p_corr > 0.05) + 20 x H_lab + 25 x I(N_RCT = 0)

4.name: The Citadel of Truth
4.evidence: OpenFDA FAERS and a vaulted, point-in-time active-comparator EHR holdout
4.trap: Immortal time and the holdout: counting the wait before the first prescription as treated time flatters any drug.
4.rule: D_chrono = 35 x L_time + 25 x Delta_purge; SS_oos = 1 - Loss_peptide / Loss_comparator

DENOISE.name: De-Noise Filter
DENOISE.effect: Strips affiliate-coded posts and collapses reposts before Rule 1 is measured.

EXPLORATORY_CLAIM.name: Exploratory Claim
EXPLORATORY_CLAIM.effect: Declares the claim exploratory: cheap, weak cover, M = 0.50 for Rule 1.

SPECIES_GUARD.name: Species Guard
SPECIES_GUARD.effect: Counts human evidence only: M = 0.20 on the species term, if any human study supports the claim.

BIAS_DETECTION.name: Bias Detection
BIAS_DETECTION.effect: Adjusts for the measured confounders before the Phantom strikes: confounding term 0, +5 HP, and the adjusted estimate is carried forward.

PREREGISTER.name: Preregister
PREREGISTER.effect: Locks one outcome and population before testing: K = 1, so p_corr = p_raw.

REPLICATION_SHIELD.name: Replication Shield
REPLICATION_SHIELD.effect: Re-runs the adjusted analysis in every EHR site; sites that replicate count as independent labs in H_lab.

TEMPORAL_GUARD.name: Temporal Guard
TEMPORAL_GUARD.effect: New-user, time-zero design: person-time before the first prescription stays unexposed.

ABLATION_STRIKE.name: Ablation Strike
ABLATION_STRIKE.effect: Drops the drug term if it does not lower loss on a validation slice of the training years.

score_rules.traps: 0.25 x 100 x traps falsified / traps faced
score_rules.efficiency: 0.15 x min(100, 100 x holdout lift % / max(1, credits spent / 10))

verdicts.VALIDATED: Predicted unseen, matched patients better than the active comparator, and the gain is unlikely to be luck (paired loss test p < 0.05).
verdicts.NOT BETTER: Survived, but did not predict unseen patients better than the active comparator.
verdicts.BASELINE: The Gatekeeper's benchmark: the matched active comparator with no drug effect.
verdicts.SHATTERED: The scroll's research integrity reached 0 HP.

science.SUPPORTED: The 95% interval for the drug's risk ratio on unseen matched patients excludes no effect, in the claimed direction.
science.REFUTED: The 95% interval excludes the smallest effect of interest: any effect in the claimed direction is too small to matter.
science.INCONCLUSIVE: The 95% interval includes both no effect and an effect that would matter: these patients cannot tell them apart.
science.NOT ASSESSED: No matched users and comparators with events, so the drug's effect could not be estimated.

seasonal.question: Does the relationship disappear after accounting for seasonal patterns?
seasonal.test: Season-adjusted rate ratio (index-date quarter) and the effect in each quarter
seasonal.rule: survives if the season-adjusted effect keeps its direction with p < 0.05 and season moves it < 50%

chronolock.question: Did the hero accidentally use information from the future?
chronolock.test: Leakage audit: immortal time in the exposure definition, and the effect with it purged
chronolock.rule: survives if exposure starts at the first fill and training precedes the holdout in calendar time

regional.question: Does the finding generalise across locations?
regional.test: Per-site rate ratios, Cochran's Q heterogeneity test, and the rural sites pooled
regional.rule: survives if Cochran's Q p >= 0.05 and the pooled rural sites show the claimed direction with p < 0.05

chance.question: Could the apparent result arise by chance?
chance.test: Permutation test: 199 label shuffles in the new-user cohort, Sidak-corrected for the scroll's search
chance.rule: survives if the Sidak-corrected permutation p < 0.05 in the claimed direction

replication.question: Does the result survive independent evaluation?
replication.test: Fit on the earlier training years, re-estimate on the last quarter of them, untouched by the fit
replication.rule: survives if the later slice alone shows the claimed direction with p < 0.05 (the vaults stay closed)

redundancy.question: Does the new signal add predictive value beyond the established baseline?
redundancy.test: Ablation on a validation slice of the training years: skill score vs the no-drug-effect baseline
redundancy.rule: survives if the drug term lowers loss on the validation slice (SS > 0), as the Ablation Strike rule

confounder.question: Could an alternative variable explain the finding?
confounder.test: Rate ratio adjusted for the named (or every measured) confounder, and which one moves it most
confounder.rule: survives if the adjusted effect keeps the claimed direction with p < 0.05

methods.M-L1-CORPUS: Corpus scrape of the simulated social posts: counts by platform, affiliate share, independent stories.
methods.M-L2-SPECIES: Species of the papers behind the scroll: non-human share of the supporting studies.
methods.M-L2-POISSON: Poisson rate ratio with a person-time offset, naive and adjusted for measured confounders and site; training years only, follow-up censored at the training cutoff.
methods.M-L2-BALANCE: Standardized mean differences of each confounder between users and comparators (training years).
methods.M-L3-SIDAK: Best of K outcome and subgroup tests (Poisson rate ratios), Sidak-corrected: p_corr = 1 - (1 - p)^K.
methods.M-L3-HLAB: Lab concentration: sum of squared shares of the evidence by lab (replicating sites count as labs).
methods.M-L3-SITES: Per-site Poisson rate ratio in each of the five EHR sites (training years).
methods.M-L3-RCT: Completed randomized human trials in the registry for the scroll's evidence topic.
methods.M-L4-IMMORTAL: Exposure-definition audit: share of the 'treated' person-time that came before the first fill.
methods.M-L4-PURGE: Immortal-time purge: the rate ratio as carried vs in a new-user, time-zero design.
methods.M-L4-GUARDIAN: Brier skill of the scroll's effect vs the comparator's risk model on 1:1 propensity-matched new users of the vaulted holdout, paired one-sided t-test; the matched risk ratio (standardized to the comparator model) with an exact conditional or Wald 95% interval gives the scientific status.
methods.M-MYSTERY-SEASONAL: Season-adjusted rate ratio (quarter of the index date) and the effect in each quarter.
methods.M-MYSTERY-CHRONOLOCK: Leakage audit: immortal time in the exposure definition, and every training row ending by the cutoff.
methods.M-MYSTERY-REGIONAL: Per-site rate ratios, Cochran's Q heterogeneity test, and the rural sites pooled.
methods.M-MYSTERY-CHANCE: Permutation test of the one-year risk difference in the new-user cohort, Sidak-corrected.
methods.M-MYSTERY-REPLICATION: Rate ratio on the earlier training years and, separately, on the last quarter of them.
methods.M-MYSTERY-REDUNDANCY: Ablation on a later slice of the training years: skill vs the no-drug-effect baseline.
methods.M-MYSTERY-CONFOUNDER: Rate ratio adjusted for the named (or every measured) confounder.
methods.M-MYSTERY-SECRET: Schema audit, Fisher's exact test and a heterogeneity z-test of a user dataset against the hero.
methods.M-TRIAL: The locked specification scored once on matched new users of the second vault (Trial of Truth).
methods.M-REPEAT: Not measured: the identical test on the unchanged scroll already ran.

brief.recommendation: Do not act on these claims. No scroll predicted unseen patients better than physiotherapy-only rehabilitation with no drug effect, and the matched holdout rules out a fall in risk as large as 20% (risk ratio 0.80) for no return to sport within a year.

evidence.text: Best surviving scroll: The Rehab Scroll reached SS = +0.0001 (paired loss test p = 0.321), which is not a reliable gain.
No return to sport within a year: REFUTED. risk ratio 1.12 (95% CI 0.98 to 1.27): the interval excludes a reduction as large as 20% (RR 0.80), so any effect is too small to matter.

misleading.text: The Wolverine Scroll ("The 'Wolverine peptide': BPC-157 heals torn tendons in days."): hardest hit by immortal time (47 HP), and shattered.
The Rehab Scroll ("BPC-157 shortens return to sport compared with physiotherapy alone, after adjusting for co-interventions."): hardest hit by no completed human RCT (25 HP).
The Rat-Tendon Scroll ("A rodent angiogenesis preprint: TB-500 doubles tendon collagen in two weeks."): hardest hit by immortal time (46 HP), and shattered.

brief.uncertainty: A fall smaller than 20% cannot be excluded, and questions whose scrolls shattered before the Citadel were never measured.
brief.truth: BPC-157 and TB-500 have no effect on human tendon recovery in this world (hazard ratio 1.0). Users are fitter, more diligent with rehab and more often on testosterone, the literature is almost all rodent work from one lab, and no completed human trial exists.

methods.M-L1-CORPUS: Corpus scrape of the simulated social posts: counts by platform, affiliate share, independent stories.
methods.M-L2-BALANCE: Standardized mean differences of each confounder between users and comparators (training years).
methods.M-L2-POISSON: Poisson rate ratio with a person-time offset, naive and adjusted for measured confounders and site; training years only, follow-up censored at the training cutoff.
methods.M-L2-SPECIES: Species of the papers behind the scroll: non-human share of the supporting studies.
methods.M-L3-HLAB: Lab concentration: sum of squared shares of the evidence by lab (replicating sites count as labs).
methods.M-L3-RCT: Completed randomized human trials in the registry for the scroll's evidence topic.
methods.M-L3-SIDAK: Best of K outcome and subgroup tests (Poisson rate ratios), Sidak-corrected: p_corr = 1 - (1 - p)^K.
methods.M-L3-SITES: Per-site Poisson rate ratio in each of the five EHR sites (training years).
methods.M-L4-GUARDIAN: Brier skill of the scroll's effect vs the comparator's risk model on 1:1 propensity-matched new users of the vaulted holdout, paired one-sided t-test; the matched risk ratio (standardized to the comparator model) with an exact conditional or Wald 95% interval gives the scientific status.
methods.M-L4-IMMORTAL: Exposure-definition audit: share of the 'treated' person-time that came before the first fill.
methods.M-L4-PURGE: Immortal-time purge: the rate ratio as carried vs in a new-user, time-zero design.
methods.M-TRIAL: The locked specification scored once on matched new users of the second vault (Trial of Truth).
